correctness.rationale: The standard graph braid subdivision criterion applies to the cubical model Q3. Reconstructed unordered disjoint-cell complex with 28 vertices,72 edges,42 squares and explicit signed boundaries; exact rational ranks 27 and39, b=(1,6,3), and boundary product zero. Independently constructed all 48 cellular signed symmetry actions and their exact action on a three-dimensional H2 cycle kernel, matching natural V; Euler-Poincare traces recover H1=wedge^2 V +(eta tensor standard_2)+det V. Full group averages vanish in H1,H2 and orientation-preserving subgroup averages yield H1 dimension1 and H2 dimension0. Finite exhaustive action on this fixed complex is a complete finite certificate for this exact one-graph claim, not a proof of other graph families.

evidence: General graph configuration chain models and planar presentations give methods and generators, not the evaluated G-action on this fixed cube.
